title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: Radio snapshot for 13–19 October 2026. NET FM is listed at FM 101 MHz with a recurring sports grid; the grid is not a dated trip-week match lineup. Malta DAB+ directories list BBC World Service, Rai Radio Uno and Radio Sportiva; WorldDAB lists BBC World Service on block 6A (181.936 MHz). BBC Sportsworld has dated general live-sport episodes on 17–18 October, and the BBC Radio 5 Live / 5 Sports Extra pages list UK Premier League commentary; neither establishes Malta reception or stream access. Rai’s weekend football programme has no 17–18 October running order in the checked listing. Kalshi EPL/Serie A category pages were checked for trip-window overlap, but market listings do not prove radio carriage, Malta eligibility, or any market-to-broadcast link. No named TWC, Gżira–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage or on-location reception was confirmed.

records.description: The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM. NET FM’s own recurring weekend grid includes two sports programmes. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the weekly grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and does not confirm match commentary or carriage of a particular event.
records.notes: NET FM’s official programme grid: https://netfm.com.mt/. The frequency is from the Broadcasting Authority; the programme names/times are from the station. The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed.

The BBC programme page’s viewer-dependent “Local time” rendering varied; the ISO offset supplies the conversion to Malta CEST (UTC+2): 15:06 / 16:06. Time-zone reference: https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/malta.html . The Sunday 11 Oct precedent is https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c9208pxyf8 and the upcoming list is https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq/broadcasts/upcoming ; its EPL billing is not a fixture list or guarantee for the following weekend.
